description: A four pole resonant filter with a saturating drive stage, giving a low pass and a high pass output

params.text: Sets the corner frequency, 20Hz to 10000Hz, and the filter is never allowed above 45 per cent of the sample rate
Sets how strongly the corner frequency is emphasised, from none to full
Blends both outputs from clean towards a saturated copy driven twice as hard

inputs.text: The signal the filter works on
Adds to the corner frequency, one volt multiplying it by ten rather than doubling it
Adds to the resonance, 1V covering the whole of the RES knob, and the total is held between none and full
Adds to the drive, 1V covering the whole of the DRIVE knob, and nothing clamps the total

outputs.text: The low passed signal, four poles falling away above the corner frequency
The input with the low passed signal taken back out of it, which gives the high pass shape

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
